Native stream evaluates each request separately through original typed decoding and NDU algorithms and retains DENY_ALL authority.
Stream limits are 256 requests, at most 1 MiB per input, bounded responses and bounded cumulative stderr; sequence, request digest, native identity, objective and generation are checked.
Malformed protocol, timeout or identity failure closes the session permanently; later evaluation cannot reuse a poisoned session.
